question.text: A block of mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math> is connected with a smooth plank of the same mass is performing oscillations. The value of the spring constant is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The block and the plank are free to move and there is no friction anywhere. The angular frequency of the oscillation is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">ω</mi><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. Find the value of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">ω</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Using the concept of reduced mass, we obtain:-
ω=kmreduced=2km         ∵mreduced=m×mm+m=m2

⇒ω=2×2001=20 rad s-1
